name: dddconv_nonneg
statement: lemma dddconv_nonneg (hf : 0 ≤ f) (hg : 0 ≤ g) : 0 ≤ f ○ᵈ g
proof:
:=
  fun _a ↦ sum_nonneg fun _x _ ↦ mul_nonneg (hf _) <| star_nonneg_iff.2 <| hg _

name: dddconv_apply_nonneg
statement: lemma dddconv_apply_nonneg (hf : 0 ≤ f) (hg : 0 ≤ g) (a : G) : 0 ≤ (f ○ᵈ g) a

name: support_ddconv
statement:
@[simp] lemma support_ddconv (hf : 0 ≤ f) (hg : 0 ≤ g) :
    support (f ∗ᵈ g) = support f + support g
proof:
:= by
  refine (support_ddconv_subset _ _).antisymm ?_
  rintro _ ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩
  rw [mem_support, ddconv_apply_add]
  exact ne_of_gt <| sum_pos' (fun c _ ↦ mul_nonneg (hf _) <| hg _) ⟨0, mem_univ _,
    mul_pos ((hf _).lt_of_ne' <| by simpa using ha) <| (hg _).lt_of_ne' <| by simpa using hb⟩

name: ddconv_pos
statement: lemma ddconv_pos (hf : 0 < f) (hg : 0 < g) : 0 < f ∗ᵈ g
proof:
:= by
  rw [Pi.lt_def] at hf hg ⊢
  obtain ⟨hf, a, ha⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨hg, b, hb⟩ := hg
  refine ⟨ddconv_nonneg hf hg, a + b, ?_⟩
  rw [ddconv_apply_add]
  exact sum_pos' (fun c _ ↦ mul_nonneg (hf _) <| hg _) ⟨0, by simpa using mul_pos ha hb⟩

name: support_dddconv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma support_dddconv (hf : 0 ≤ f) (hg : 0 ≤ g) : support (f ○ᵈ g) = support f - support g
proof:
:= by
  simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using support_ddconv hf (conjneg_nonneg.2 hg)

name: dddconv_pos
statement: lemma dddconv_pos (hf : 0 < f) (hg : 0 < g) : 0 < f ○ᵈ g
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ddconv_conjneg]; exact ddconv_pos hf (conjneg_pos.2 hg)

name: iterConv_nonneg
statement:
@[simp] lemma iterConv_nonneg (hf : 0 ≤ f) : ∀ {n}, 0 ≤ f ∗ᵈ^ n
  | 0 => fun _ ↦ by dsimp; split_ifs <;> norm_num
  | n + 1 => ddconv_nonneg (iterConv_nonneg hf) hf

end OrderedCommSemiring

section StrictOrderedCommSemiring
variable [CommSemiring R] [PartialOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [StarRing R] [StarOrderedRing R]
  {f g : G → R} {n : ℕ}

@[simp] lemma iterConv_pos (hf : 0 < f) : ∀ {n}, 0 < f ∗ᵈ^ n
  | 0 => Pi.lt_def.2 ⟨iterConv_nonneg hf.le, 0, by simp⟩
  | n + 1 => ddconv_pos (iterConv_pos hf) hf

end StrictOrderedCommSemiring

lemma cLpNorm_two_mul_sum_pow [Fintype α] {ι : Type*} {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (s : Finset ι)
    (f : ι → α → ℂ) :
    ‖∑ i ∈ s, f i‖ₙ_[2 * n] ^ (2 * n) =
      ∑ x ∈ s ^^ n, ∑ y ∈ s ^^ n, 𝔼 a, (∏ i, conj (f (x i) a)) * ∏ i, f (y i) a
proof:
:=
  calc
    _ = 𝔼 a, (‖∑ i ∈ s, f i a‖ : ℂ) ^ (2 * n) := by
      norm_cast
      rw [← cLpNorm_pow_eq_expect_norm (by positivity)]
      simp_rw [← Finset.sum_apply]
    _ = 𝔼 a, (∑ i ∈ s, conj (f i a)) ^ n * (∑ j ∈ s, f j a) ^ n := by
      simp_rw [pow_mul, ← Complex.conj_mul', mul_pow, map_sum]
    _ = _ := by simp_rw [sum_pow', sum_mul_sum, expect_sum_comm]

    cLpNorm_rpow_eq_expect_norm hp, cLpNorm_rpow_eq_expect_norm (mul_ne_zero hq hp)]

statement:
@[simp]
lemma cLpNorm_translate [NormedAddCommGroup E] (a : G) (f : G → E) : ‖τ a f‖ₙ_[p] = ‖f‖ₙ_[p]
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_fintype G
  obtain p | p := p
  · simp only [cLpNorm_exponent_top_eq_essSup, ENNReal.none_eq_top, translate_apply]
    exact (Equiv.subRight _).iSup_congr fun _ ↦ rfl
  obtain rfl | hp := eq_or_ne p 0
  · simp only [cLpNorm_exponent_zero, ENNReal.some_eq_coe, ENNReal.coe_zero]
  · simp only [cLpNorm_eq_expect_norm hp, ENNReal.some_eq_coe, translate_apply]
    congr 1
    exact Fintype.expect_equiv (Equiv.subRight _) _ _ fun _ ↦ rfl

name: cLpNorm_conjneg
statement: @[simp] lemma cLpNorm_conjneg [RCLike E] (f : G → E) : ‖conjneg f‖ₙ_[p] = ‖f‖ₙ_[p]
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_fintype G
  simp only [conjneg, cLpNorm_conj]
  obtain p | p := p
  · simp only [cLpNorm_exponent_top_eq_essSup, ENNReal.none_eq_top]
    exact (Equiv.neg _).iSup_congr fun _ ↦ rfl
  obtain rfl | hp := eq_or_ne p 0
  · simp only [cLpNorm_exponent_zero, ENNReal.some_eq_coe, ENNReal.coe_zero]
  · simp only [cLpNorm_eq_expect_norm hp, ENNReal.some_eq_coe]
    congr 1
    exact Fintype.expect_equiv (Equiv.neg _) _ _ fun _ ↦ rfl

name: cLpNorm_translate_sum_sub_le
statement:
lemma cLpNorm_translate_sum_sub_le [NormedAddCommGroup E] (hp : 1 ≤ p) {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (a : ι → G) (f : G → E) : ‖τ (∑ i ∈ s, a i) f - f‖ₙ_[p] ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ‖τ (a i) f - f‖ₙ_[p]
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => simp
  | cons i s ih hs =>
  calc
    _ = ‖τ (∑ j ∈ s, a j) (τ (a i) f - f) + (τ (∑ j ∈ s, a j) f - f)‖ₙ_[p] := by
        rw [sum_cons, translate_add', translate_sub_right, sub_add_sub_cancel]
    _ ≤ ‖τ (∑ j ∈ s, a j) (τ (a i) f - f)‖ₙ_[p] + ∑ j ∈ s, ‖(τ (a j) f - f)‖ₙ_[p] := by
      grw [cLpNorm_add_le hp, hs]
    _ = _ := by rw [cLpNorm_translate, sum_cons]

name: wLpNorm_mono_right
statement:
@[gcongr]
lemma wLpNorm_mono_right
    (hw : ∑ i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) = 1) (hpq : p ≤ q) (f : α → E) :
    ‖f‖_[p, w] ≤ ‖f‖_[q, w]
proof:
:= by
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (Measure.sum fun i ↦ (w i : ℝ≥0) • Measure.dirac (i : α)) := by
    rw [isProbabilityMeasure_iff, Measure.sum_apply _ MeasurableSet.univ]
    simp [hw, ← Measure.coe_nnreal_smul]
  rw [wLpNorm, wLpNorm,
      ← toReal_eLpNorm (μ := Measure.sum fun i ↦ (w i : ℝ≥0) • Measure.dirac i)
        (MemLp.of_discrete (p := p)).aestronglyMeasurable,
      ← toReal_eLpNorm (μ := Measure.sum fun i ↦ (w i : ℝ≥0) • Measure.dirac i)
        (MemLp.of_discrete (p := q)).aestronglyMeasurable]
  exact ENNReal.toReal_mono (MemLp.of_discrete (p := q)).eLpNorm_ne_top
    (eLpNorm_le_eLpNorm_of_exponent_le hpq (MemLp.of_discrete (p := p)).aestronglyMeasurable)

name: dLpNorm_two_mul_sum_pow
statement:
lemma dLpNorm_two_mul_sum_pow {ι : Type*} {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → α → ℂ) :
    ‖∑ i ∈ s, f i‖_[2 * n] ^ (2 * n) =
      ∑ x ∈ s ^^ n, ∑ y ∈ s ^^ n, ∑ a, (∏ i, conj (f (x i) a)) * ∏ i, f (y i) a
proof:
:=
  calc
    _ = ∑ a, (‖∑ i ∈ s, f i a‖ : ℂ) ^ (2 * n) := by
      norm_cast
      rw [← dLpNorm_pow_eq_sum_norm (by positivity)]
      simp_rw [← Finset.sum_apply]
    _ = ∑ a, (∑ i ∈ s, conj (f i a)) ^ n * (∑ j ∈ s, f j a) ^ n := by
      simp_rw [pow_mul, ← Complex.conj_mul', mul_pow, map_sum]
    _ = _ := by simp_rw [sum_pow', sum_mul_sum, sum_comm (s := univ)]

name: dLpNorm_rpow
statement:
lemma dLpNorm_rpow (hp : p ≠ 0) (hq : q ≠ 0) (hf : 0 ≤ f) :
    ‖f ^ (q : ℝ)‖_[p] = ‖f‖_[p * q] ^ (q : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_fintype α
  refine rpow_left_injOn (NNReal.coe_ne_zero.2 hp) (by dsimp; positivity)
    (by dsimp; positivity) ?_
  dsimp
  rw [← rpow_mul (by positivity), ← mul_comm, ← ENNReal.coe_mul, ← NNReal.coe_mul,
    dLpNorm_rpow_eq_sum_norm hp, dLpNorm_rpow_eq_sum_norm (mul_ne_zero hq hp)]
  simp [abs_rpow_of_nonneg (hf _), ← rpow_mul]

name: dLpNorm_pow
statement:
lemma dLpNorm_pow (hp : p ≠ 0) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0) (f : α → ℂ) :
    ‖f ^ q‖_[p] = ‖f‖_[p * q] ^ q
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_fintype α
  refine rpow_left_injOn (NNReal.coe_ne_zero.2 hp) (by dsimp; positivity)
    (by dsimp; positivity) ?_
  dsimp
  rw [← rpow_natCast_mul (by positivity), ← mul_comm, ← ENNReal.coe_natCast, ← ENNReal.coe_mul,
    ← NNReal.coe_natCast, ← NNReal.coe_mul, dLpNorm_rpow_eq_sum_norm hp,
    dLpNorm_rpow_eq_sum_norm (by positivity)]
  simp [← rpow_natCast_mul]

name: dL1Norm_rpow
statement: lemma dL1Norm_rpow (hq : q ≠ 0) (hf : 0 ≤ f) : ‖f ^ (q : ℝ)‖_[1] = ‖f‖_[q] ^ (q : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] using dLpNorm_rpow one_ne_zero hq hf

name: dL1Norm_pow

name: dLpNorm_eq_dL1Norm_rpow

lemma dLpNorm_eq_dL1Norm_rpow (hp : p ≠ 0) (f : α → 𝕜) :

  simp [dLpNorm_eq_sum_norm hp, dL1Norm_eq_sum_norm, abs_rpow_of_nonneg]

name: dLpNorm_rpow'
statement:
lemma dLpNorm_rpow' {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp₀ : p ≠ 0) (hp : p ≠ ∞) (hq : q ≠ 0) (f : α → 𝕜) :
    ‖f‖_[p] ^ (q : ℝ) = ‖(fun a ↦ ‖f a‖) ^ (q : ℝ)‖_[p / q]
proof:
:= by
  lift p to ℝ≥0 using hp
  simp only [ne_eq, ENNReal.coe_eq_zero] at hp₀
  rw [← ENNReal.coe_div hq, dLpNorm_rpow (div_ne_zero hp₀ hq) hq (fun _ ↦ norm_nonneg _),
    dLpNorm_norm .of_discrete, ← ENNReal.coe_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hq]

name: RCLike.dLpNorm_coe_comp

lemma RCLike.dLpNorm_coe_comp [RCLike 𝕜] (p) (f : α → ℝ) : ‖((↑) : ℝ → 𝕜) ∘ f‖_[p] = ‖f‖_[p]

name: indicator_one_iterConv_apply
statement:
lemma indicator_one_iterConv_apply (s : Finset G) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : G), (𝟭_[s, R] ∗ᵈ^ n) a = #{x ∈ s ^^ n | ∑ i, x i = a}
  | 0, a => by simp [apply_ite card, eq_comm]
  | n + 1, a => by
    simp_rw [iterConv_succ', ddconv_eq_sum_sub', indicator_one_iterConv_apply, Set.indicator_apply,
      boole_mul, sum_ite, mem_coe, filter_univ_mem, sum_const_zero, add_zero, ← Nat.cast_sum,
      ← Finset.card_sigma]
    congr 1
    refine card_equiv ((Equiv.sigmaEquivProd ..).trans <| Fin.consEquiv fun _ ↦ G) ?_
    aesop (add simp [Fin.sum_cons, Fin.forall_fin_succ])

  apply sum_nbij' (fun ⟨(_b, c), (d, e)⟩ ↦ ⟨(d, e + c), (e, c)⟩)

  simp_rw [ddconv_eq_sum_sub', sum_mul]
  rw [sum_comm]
  exact sum_congr rfl fun x _ ↦ Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.subRight x) _ _ fun y ↦ by simp

name: wInner_one_le_dLpNorm_mul_dLpNorm
statement:
lemma wInner_one_le_dLpNorm_mul_dLpNorm (p q : ℝ≥0∞) [p.HolderConjugate q] :
    ⟪f, g⟫_[ℝ] ≤ ‖f‖_[p] * ‖g‖_[q]
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := ENNReal.HolderConjugate.ne_zero p q
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := ENNReal.HolderConjugate.ne_zero q p
  have hwInner : ⟪f, g⟫_[ℝ] = ∑ i, f i * g i := by simp [wInner_one_eq_sum, mul_comm]
  have hfg i : f i * g i ≤ ‖f i‖ * ‖g i‖ :=
    (le_abs_self _).trans_eq (by rw [abs_mul]; simp [Real.norm_eq_abs])
  obtain rfl | hpi := eq_or_ne p ∞
  · obtain rfl : q = 1 := (ENNReal.HolderConjugate.eq_top_iff_eq_one ∞ q).mp rfl
    simp only [hwInner, dL1Norm_eq_sum_norm, norm_eq_abs, dLinftyNorm_eq_iSup_norm, mul_sum]
    gcongr ∑ _, ?_ with i
    grw [le_abs_self (_ * _), abs_mul, ← le_ciSup (Finite.bddAbove_range _)]
  obtain rfl | hqi := eq_or_ne q ∞
  · obtain rfl : p = 1 := (ENNReal.HolderConjugate.eq_top_iff_eq_one ∞ p).mp rfl
    simp only [hwInner, dL1Norm_eq_sum_norm, norm_eq_abs, dLinftyNorm_eq_iSup_norm, sum_mul]
    gcongr ∑ _, ?_ with i
    grw [le_abs_self (_ * _), abs_mul, ← le_ciSup (Finite.bddAbove_range _)]
  have hpr : 0 < p.toReal := ENNReal.toReal_pos hp0 hpi
  have hqr : 0 < q.toReal := ENNReal.toReal_pos hq0 hqi
  have hreal : Real.HolderConjugate p.toReal q.toReal := by
    simpa using ENNReal.HolderTriple.toReal (p := p) (q := q) (r := 1) hpr hqr
  rw [hwInner, dLpNorm_eq_sum_norm' hp0 hpi, dLpNorm_eq_sum_norm' hq0 hqi]
  simpa using Real.inner_le_Lp_mul_Lq Finset.univ f g hreal

statement:

name: dLpNorm_mul_le
statement: lemma dLpNorm_mul_le (p q : ℝ≥0∞) [p.HolderTriple q r] : ‖f * g‖_[r] ≤ ‖f‖_[p] * ‖g‖_[q]
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_fintype α
  change lpNorm (f * g) r .count ≤ lpNorm f p .count * lpNorm g q .count
  have hfg : AEStronglyMeasurable (f * g) .count := .of_discrete
  grw [← toReal_eLpNorm .of_discrete, ← toReal_eLpNorm .of_discrete, ← toReal_eLpNorm .of_discrete,
    ← ENNReal.toReal_mul, ← eLpNorm_mul_le_mul_eLpNorm (r := r) .of_discrete .of_discrete]
  exact (ENNReal.mul_lt_top eLpNorm_lt_top_of_finite eLpNorm_lt_top_of_finite).ne

name: dLpNorm_prod_le
statement:
lemma dLpNorm_prod_le {ι : Type*} {s : Finset ι} (hs : s.Nonempty) {p : ι → ℝ≥0} (hp : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0)
    (q : ℝ≥0) (hpq : ∑ i ∈ s, ((p i)⁻¹ : ℝ≥0∞) = (q : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) (f : ι → α → 𝕜) :
    ‖∏ i ∈ s, f i‖_[q] ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖_[p i]
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction generalizing q with
  | empty => cases not_nonempty_empty hs
  | cons i s hi ih =>
    obtain rfl | hs := s.eq_empty_or_nonempty
    · simp only [sum_cons, sum_empty, add_zero, inv_inj] at hpq
      simp [← hpq]
    simp_rw [prod_cons]
    rw [sum_cons, ← inv_inv (∑ _ ∈ _, _)] at hpq
    have : ENNReal.HolderTriple (p i) ↑(∑ i ∈ s, (p i)⁻¹)⁻¹ q := ⟨by
      simpa [ENNReal.coe_inv (by simpa [hp] :
        (∑ j ∈ s, (p j)⁻¹ : ℝ≥0) ≠ 0), ENNReal.coe_inv, hp] using hpq⟩
    grw [dLpNorm_mul_le (p i) ↑(∑ i ∈ s, (p i)⁻¹)⁻¹, ih hs]
    rw [← ENNReal.coe_inv, inv_inv]
    · push_cast
      congr! with i
      exact (ENNReal.coe_inv <| hp _).symm
    · simpa [hp]

proof:
:= by
  simp only [wInner_cWeight_eq_smul_wInner_one, ← NNRat.cast_smul_eq_nnqsmul ℝ≥0, NNRat.cast_inv,
    NNRat.cast_natCast, NNReal.smul_def, NNReal.coe_inv, NNReal.coe_natCast, smul_eq_mul,
    cL2Norm_eq_expect_norm, expect, card_univ, norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  rw [mul_rpow, mul_rpow, mul_mul_mul_comm, ← sq, ← rpow_two, rpow_inv_rpow]
  any_goals positivity
  gcongr
  simpa [dL2Norm_eq_sum_norm] using wInner_one_le_dL2Norm_mul_dL2Norm f g

name: cLpNorm_mul_le
statement:
lemma cLpNorm_mul_le (p q : ℝ≥0∞) (_hr₀ : r ≠ 0) [hpqr : ENNReal.HolderTriple p q r] :
    ‖f * g‖ₙ_[r] ≤ ‖f‖ₙ_[p] * ‖g‖ₙ_[q]
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_fintype α
  set μ := ProbabilityTheory.uniformOn (Set.univ : Set α) with hμ_def
  have hμfin : IsFiniteMeasure μ := by rw [hμ_def]; infer_instance
  have hm_r : MemLp (f * g) r μ := MemLp.of_discrete
  have hm_p : MemLp f p μ := MemLp.of_discrete
  have hm_q : MemLp g q μ := MemLp.of_discrete
  have hbd : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖f x * g x‖₊ ≤ (1 : NNReal) * ‖f x‖₊ * ‖g x‖₊ :=
    .of_forall fun x ↦ by rw [one_mul]; exact nnnorm_mul_le _ _
  have key : eLpNorm (fun x ↦ f x * g x) r μ
      ≤ ((1 : NNReal) : ℝ≥0∞) * eLpNorm f p μ * eLpNorm g q μ :=
    eLpNorm_le_eLpNorm_mul_eLpNorm_of_nnnorm (p := p) (q := q) (r := r)
      hm_p.aestronglyMeasurable hm_q.aestronglyMeasurable (· * ·) 1 hbd
  change lpNorm _ _ μ ≤ lpNorm _ _ μ * lpNorm _ _ μ
  rw [← toReal_eLpNorm hm_r.aestronglyMeasurable,
      ← toReal_eLpNorm hm_p.aestronglyMeasurable,
      ← toReal_eLpNorm hm_q.aestronglyMeasurable,
      ← ENNReal.toReal_mul]
  apply ENNReal.toReal_mono
  · exact ENNReal.mul_ne_top hm_p.eLpNorm_ne_top hm_q.eLpNorm_ne_top
  · simpa [Pi.mul_def] using key

name: cL1Norm_mul_of_nonneg

name: wInner_cWeight_le_cLpNorm_mul_cLpNorm
statement:
lemma wInner_cWeight_le_cLpNorm_mul_cLpNorm (p q : ℝ≥0∞) [p.HolderConjugate q] :
    ⟪f, g⟫ₙ_[ℝ] ≤ ‖f‖ₙ_[p] * ‖g‖ₙ_[q]
proof:
:= by
  
  have h_abs : ⟪f, g⟫ₙ_[ℝ] ≤ ⟪fun i ↦ |f i|, fun i ↦ |g i|⟫ₙ_[ℝ] := by
    simp_rw [wInner_cWeight_eq_expect]
    refine expect_le_expect fun i _ ↦ ?_
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans (abs_mul _ _).le
  refine h_abs.trans ?_
  
  
  
  have hfabs : ‖fun i ↦ |f i|‖ₙ_[p] = ‖f‖ₙ_[p] := by
    simpa using cLpNorm_fun_abs (f := f) (p := p) .of_discrete
  have hgabs : ‖fun i ↦ |g i|‖ₙ_[q] = ‖g‖ₙ_[q] := by
    simpa using cLpNorm_fun_abs (f := g) (p := q) .of_discrete
  rw [← hfabs, ← hgabs]
  rw [show ⟪fun i ↦ |f i|, fun i ↦ |g i|⟫ₙ_[ℝ]
        = ‖(fun i ↦ |f i|) * (fun i ↦ |g i|)‖ₙ_[1] from
        (cL1Norm_mul_of_nonneg (f := fun i ↦ |f i|) (g := fun i ↦ |g i|)
          (fun i ↦ abs_nonneg _) (fun i ↦ abs_nonneg _)).symm]
  exact cLpNorm_mul_le p q one_ne_zero

name: abs_wInner_cWeight_le_dLpNorm_mul_dLpNorm
statement:
lemma abs_wInner_cWeight_le_dLpNorm_mul_dLpNorm (p q : ℝ≥0∞) [p.HolderConjugate q] :
    |⟪f, g⟫ₙ_[ℝ]| ≤ ‖f‖ₙ_[p] * ‖g‖ₙ_[q]

    _ ≤ ‖fun a ↦ ‖f a‖‖ₙ_[p] * ‖fun a ↦ ‖g a‖‖ₙ_[q] := wInner_cWeight_le_cLpNorm_mul_cLpNorm _ _

name: cLpNorm_prod_le
statement:
lemma cLpNorm_prod_le [Finite α] {ι : Type*} {s : Finset ι} (hs : s.Nonempty)
    {p : ι → ℝ≥0} (hp : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0)
    (q : ℝ≥0) (hpq : ∑ i ∈ s, ((p i)⁻¹ : ℝ≥0∞) = (q : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) (f : ι → α → 𝕜) :
    ‖∏ i ∈ s, f i‖ₙ_[q] ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖ₙ_[p i]
proof:
:= by
  induction hs using Finset.Nonempty.cons_induction generalizing q with
  | singleton => simp_all
  | cons i s hi hs ih =>
  simp_rw [prod_cons]
  rw [sum_cons, ← inv_inv (∑ _ ∈ _, _)] at hpq
  have : ENNReal.HolderTriple (p i) ↑(∑ i ∈ s, (p i)⁻¹)⁻¹ q := ⟨by
    simpa [ENNReal.coe_inv (by simpa [hp] :
      (∑ j ∈ s, (p j)⁻¹ : ℝ≥0) ≠ 0), ENNReal.coe_inv, hp] using hpq⟩
  grw [cLpNorm_mul_le (p i) ↑(∑ i ∈ s, (p i)⁻¹)⁻¹ , ih]
  · rw [← ENNReal.coe_inv, inv_inv]
    · push_cast
      congr! with i
      exact (ENNReal.coe_inv <| hp _).symm
    · simpa [hp]
  · norm_cast
    rintro rfl

name: convolution_assoc'''
statement:
theorem convolution_assoc''' (hL : ∀ x y z, L₂ (L x y) z = L₃ x (L₄ y z))
    (hfg : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ, ConvolutionExistsAt f g y L ν)
    (hgk : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, ConvolutionExistsAt g k x L₄ μ)
    (hi : ∀ x₀,
      Integrable (uncurry fun x y => (L₃ (f y)) ((L₄ (g (x - y))) (k (x₀ - x)))) (μ.prod ν)) :
    (f ⋆[L, ν] g) ⋆[L₂, μ] k = f ⋆[L₃, ν] (g ⋆[L₄, μ] k)
proof:
:=
  funext fun _ ↦ convolution_assoc' _ _ _ _ hL hfg hgk (hi _)

name: convolution_assoc''
statement:
theorem convolution_assoc'' (hL : ∀ x y z, L₂ (L x y) z = L₃ x (L₄ y z))
    (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f ν) (hg : AEStronglyMeasurable g μ) (hk : AEStronglyMeasurable k μ)
    (hfg : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ, ConvolutionExistsAt f g y L ν)
    (hgk : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, ConvolutionExistsAt (‖g ·‖) (‖k ·‖) x (mul ℝ ℝ) μ)
    (hfgk : ConvolutionExists (‖f ·‖) ((‖g ·‖) ⋆[mul ℝ ℝ, μ] (‖k ·‖)) (mul ℝ ℝ) ν) :
    (f ⋆[L, ν] g) ⋆[L₂, μ] k = f ⋆[L₃, ν] (g ⋆[L₄, μ] k)
proof:
:=
  funext fun _ ↦ convolution_assoc _ _ _ _ hL hf hg hk hfg hgk (hfgk _)

name: convolution_translate

name: codim_iInf_ker_le_fintypeCard
statement:
lemma codim_iInf_ker_le_fintypeCard [Fintype ι] :
    finrank K V - (⨅ i, (f i).ker).finrank ≤ Fintype.card ι
proof:
:= by
  let F : V →ₗ[K] (ι → K) := {
    toFun x i := f i x
    map_add' x y := by ext i; simp
    map_smul' c x := by ext i; simp
  }
  have hker : F.ker = ⨅ i, (f i).ker := by ext x; simp [F, funext_iff]
  grw [← hker, ← F.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker, Submodule.finrank_le]
  simp [Submodule.finrank]

name: mem_closure_iff
statement:
lemma mem_closure_iff : ψ ∈ AddSubgroup.closure Δ ↔ ∀ x, (∀ γ ∈ Δ, γ x = 1) → ψ x = 1 where
  mp hψ x hx
proof:
:= map_eq_one_of_mem_closure hψ hx
  mpr hψ := by
    contrapose! hψ
    let H : AddSubgroup (AddChar G ℂ) := AddSubgroup.closure Δ
    have hquot : QuotientAddGroup.mk ψ ≠ (0 : AddChar G ℂ ⧸ H) := fun h ↦ hψ <| by simpa using h
    obtain ⟨χ, hχ⟩ := exists_apply_ne_zero.2 hquot
    let χ' : AddChar (AddChar G ℂ) ℂ := χ.compAddMonoidHom (QuotientAddGroup.mk' H)
    refine ⟨doubleDualEquiv.symm χ', fun γ hγ ↦ ?_, by simpa [χ'] using hχ⟩
    have hγH : γ ∈ H := AddSubgroup.subset_closure hγ
    simp [χ', (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).2 hγH]

name: expect_iInf_ker_eq_one_of_mem_closure
statement:
lemma expect_iInf_ker_eq_one_of_mem_closure (hV : V = ⨅ γ ∈ Δ, γ.toAddMonoidHom.ker)
    (hψ : ψ ∈ AddSubgroup.closure Δ) : 𝔼 x ∈ Set.toFinset V, ψ x = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hψV x (hx : x ∈ V) : ψ x = 1 := map_eq_one_of_mem_closure hψ (by simpa [hV] using hx)
  calc
    𝔼 x ∈ Set.toFinset V, ψ x = 𝔼 _x ∈ Set.toFinset V, (1 : ℂ) :=
      Finset.expect_congr rfl fun x hx ↦ hψV x (by simpa using hx)
    _ = 1 := Finset.expect_const ⟨0, by simp⟩ _

name: expect_iInf_ker_eq_zero_of_not_mem_closure
statement:
lemma expect_iInf_ker_eq_zero_of_not_mem_closure (hV : V = ⨅ γ ∈ Δ, γ.toAddMonoidHom.ker)
    (hψ : ψ ∉ AddSubgroup.closure Δ) : 𝔼 x ∈ Set.toFinset V, ψ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hxΔ, hxψ⟩ : ∃ x, (∀ γ ∈ Δ, γ x = 1) ∧ ψ x ≠ 1 := by
    simpa [AddChar.mem_closure_iff] using hψ
  let ψV : AddChar V ℂ := ψ.compAddMonoidHom V.subtype
  calc
    𝔼 x ∈ Set.toFinset V, ψ x
      = (∑ x ∈ Set.toFinset V, ψ x) / #(Set.toFinset V) := by rw [Finset.expect_eq_sum_div_card]
    _ = (∑ x, ψV x) / Fintype.card V := by
      have hsum : ∑ x ∈ Set.toFinset (V : Set G), ψ x = ∑ x : V, ψ x :=
        Finset.sum_subtype (Set.toFinset (V : Set G)) (by intro x; simp) fun x ↦ ψ x
      simp [hsum, ψV]
    _ = 0 := by
      simp only [div_eq_zero_iff, sum_eq_zero_iff_ne_zero, ne_eq, Nat.cast_eq_zero,
        Fintype.card_ne_zero, or_false]
      intro hzero
      apply hxψ
      simpa [ψV] using DFunLike.congr_fun hzero ⟨x, by simpa [hV] using hxΔ⟩

name: exists_pos_cos_mul_nonpos_of_pos
statement:
private lemma exists_pos_cos_mul_nonpos_of_pos {θ : ℝ} (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hθπ : θ ≤ π) :
    ∃ n > (0 : ℕ), cos ((n : ℝ) * θ) ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⌈π / 2 / θ⌉₊, by positivity, cos_nonpos_of_pi_div_two_le_of_le ?_ ?_⟩
  · grw [← Nat.le_ceil]
    simp [hθ0.ne']
  · grw [Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (by positivity), add_one_mul]
    simpa [hθ0.ne', add_comm]

name: exists_pos_cos_mul_nonpos
statement:
private lemma exists_pos_cos_mul_nonpos {θ : ℝ} (hθ₁ : -π < θ) (hθ₂ : θ ≤ π) (hθ : θ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ n > (0 : ℕ), cos ((n : ℝ) * θ) ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain (_hθ | hθ) := hθ.lt_or_gt
  · simpa using exists_pos_cos_mul_nonpos_of_pos (θ := -θ) (by linarith) (by linarith)
  · exact exists_pos_cos_mul_nonpos_of_pos hθ hθ₂

name: eq_one_of_forall_pow_mem_rightHalfArc
statement:
private lemma eq_one_of_forall_pow_mem_rightHalfArc {z : Circle}
    (hz : ∀ n > 0, z ^ n ∈ rightHalfArc) : z = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Circle.arg_eq_zero]
  by_contra hθ
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hcos⟩ :=
    exists_pos_cos_mul_nonpos (Complex.neg_pi_lt_arg _) (Complex.arg_le_pi _) hθ
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hzt⟩ := hz n hn
  have : cos (n * (z : ℂ).arg) = cos t := Circle.cos_eq_cos_of_exp_eq_exp (by simp [*])
  linarith [cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo ht]
